evidence.quote: Front and center among these risks is that of runnable liabilities.

So I continue to believe that the post-crisis work to create a solid regime to protect financial stability cannot be deemed complete without a well-considered approach to regulating runnable funding outside, as well as inside, the regulatory perimeter.
It implicates some elements of monetary policy, as well as moral hazard issues and other recurring factors in financial regulation.

parsed.rationale: The speech addresses shadow banking, runnable funding and safe-asset supply from a financial regulation perspective. It takes no position on interest rates, inflation, activity or the balance sheet, so the stance is neutral.
